anchor.2: Materially flawed; would require review or correction.
anchor.4: Good production-quality response with minor issues only.
anchor.5: Excellent response for the scenario and channel.

dimensions.name: Empathy and rapport
dimensions.description: Acknowledges the customer's situation without over-apologizing or sounding scripted.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.description: Explains next steps, decisions, and constraints in concise customer-facing language.

dimensions.name: Voice naturalness
dimensions.description: Would sound natural when spoken aloud, with no awkward repetition or robotic phrasing.

dimensions.name: Professionalism
dimensions.description: Maintains a calm support tone and avoids blame, speculation, or inappropriate informality.

dimensions.name: Resolution communication
dimensions.description: Accurately communicates what was done, what remains, and what the customer should expect.

dimensions.name: Voice-channel fit
dimensions.description: Uses language that is easy to follow in a live voice interaction.
